label: conjecture
setting: two summands, generic target (not order two, t != 0, 3t^2+a != 0), prime p with 2^k | p-1; V_D(k) is the degree-D chain-quotient closure of csd/ic_bounds_d5_verify.py; I_k the ideal; M_<=D the squarefree monomials of weight <= D

conjecture.first_fall: V_D(k) = I_k cap M_<=D for k < 4D-10 and V_D(4D-10) != I_k cap M_<=D (D >= 3)
conjecture.base_depth: least k0 with W_{k0+1}(V_D(k0)) closed and equal to V_D(k0+1) is k0 = 4D-9 (one above the first fall)
conjecture.recursion: p_j(k+1) = p_j(k) + 2 p_{j-1}(k) + p_{j-2}(k) for every k >= 4D-10
conjecture.lfd: LFD(k) = floor((k+14)/4) for generic two-summand unit-ideal systems
conjecture.evidence: exact: D=3 (fall 2, base 3; 3 instances), D=4 (fall 6, base 7; 3 generic + order-two + tangent), D=5 (fall 10; base: see experiments/ic-bounds-freeext/README.md); the t=0 target (X=0, a=1, b=0) does not fall through k=9 at D=4
